name: Subfin-NG
description: OpenSubsonic API for Jellyfin. Use Subsonic/Navidrome clients (DSub, Substreamer, etc.) with your Jellyfin music library and Jellyfin accounts.
overview: Exposes an OpenSubsonic-compatible API at /opensubsonic so that Subsonic clients can browse and stream your Jellyfin music library, signing in with Jellyfin accounts.
